data.description: Columbus City Council Public Safety & Criminal Justice Committee hearing concerning the city's use of Flock Safety automatic license plate readers and the Columbus Division of Police audit. The hearing occurred Aug. 10, 2026 at City Hall. Axios reported on Aug. 12 that it lasted nearly six hours and received testimony from 55 residents, with feedback overwhelmingly negative. Columbus police defended the technology's usefulness and pointed to sharing restrictions and safeguards. The official Columbus CTV catalog lists the hearing media item.

data.outcome: Hearing completed with nearly six hours of proceedings and testimony from 55 residents, according to Axios; public feedback was overwhelmingly negative. No final Council vote or renewal decision identified. The current Flock contract is a $228,000 two-year agreement, and Axios reports a December 2026 renewal-or-lapse decision point.
